summary: Unofficial simulator of the BCEAO PI-SPI API Business: OAuth2 token, payment requests, received payments, returns of funds, aliases and signed webhooks.
warning: In production the API Business requires an mTLS client certificate issued by the BCEAO certificate authority (PICERT), and the OAuth2 token is bound to that certificate. This simulator accepts calls without a certificate, like the official sandbox: plan for the certificate before going live.
notes: This simulator adds failure scenarios to the official BCEAO sandbox; it does not replace it.
Your Overpass test key goes in the x-api-key header; the simulator accepts any client_id and client_secret on /oauth/token.
The virtual payer answers at once: request accepted (IRREVOCABLE) or rejected with the scenario's reason, AM04 for insufficient funds, AB03 for a timeout.
Paths follow the specification's server: /piz/v1/...; the token comes from /oauth/token.
Webhooks go to the target chosen on the Simulator; POST /webhooks records the registration as documented, without changing that target.
The X-Signature uses the secret shown on the track for your test key.
Retries: five attempts over about 37 minutes; the specification gives no schedule.
The participant code in end2endId values (CIB001) and the payer's name are made up.

endpoints.GET /piz/v1/paiements-recus/:txId: Read the last payment received for a txId
endpoints.PUT /piz/v1/paiements/:end2endId/retours: Return the funds of a payment

steps.token: Get an OAuth2 token with client_credentials, your test key in x-api-key.
steps.request: Send a 15,000 XOF payment request with that token.
steps.read: Read the request again: the virtual payer paid it according to the scenario.
steps.webhook: Receive the webhook on your computer with overpass-cli.
